title: Introduce cohort-progression smoother and stable-cutover gate
author: Daniel Park
release_notes: Adds a cohort-aware smoothing layer that reduces false-positive canary regressions during phased rollouts and a stable-cutover gate that enforces conservative progression when signal volatility is high.
description:
Context and motivation: We frequently see transient spikes in latency or throughput that correlate with small cohort shifts (time-of-day, client mix) and cause the canary system to prematurely pause or rollback rollouts. This PR implements two related mechanisms: (1) Cohort-progression Smoother, a lightweight temporal smoothing and cohort-weighted aggregation that stabilizes short-lived fluctuations while preserving sensitivity to sustained regressions; and (2) Stable-Cutover Gate, a rollout guard that enforces stricter progression criteria (longer observation windows, higher confidence thresholds, and adaptive rollback budgets) when the signal shows high entropy or cohort churn.

Design summary: The smoother maintains per-cohort rolling quantiles for latency and throughput and computes a cohesion score that down-weights cohorts whose metrics deviate transiently from the overall trend. The gate consumes cohesion + uncertainty metrics and adjusts the canary progression state machine: when cohesion is low the gate lengthens stage durations, requires multi-cohort agreement for cutover, and limits step size. When cohesion returns, the gate automatically shortens windows. This is intentionally additive: it plugs into the existing canary evaluator pipeline (probe scheduler -> metric aggregator -> decision engine) and exposes knobs for SLO-weighted sensitivity.

Key changes (high-level files):
- pkg/canary/smoother.go: new cohort smoothing and cohesion scoring logic (with package-level unit tests).
- pkg/canary/gate.go: stable-cutover gate implemented with state transitions and metrics export.
- pkg/canary/config.yaml: runtime knobs for window sizes, decay factors, cohesion thresholds.
- internal/probes/scheduler.lua: probe scheduling adjustments to ensure cohort-balanced sampling.
- test/e2e/cohort_rollout_test.go: synthetic traffic harness to validate behavior under cohort churn.
- docs/perf/canary-smoother.md: design doc and operator guidance.
- ci/metrics-checks.yml: new CI scenario to run the e2e under varied traffic shapes.

Commits:

- 490b1bc Hook up metrics and dashboards for cohesion/entropy
- 1d2f3a4 Add e2e harness and CI job for synthetic cohort churn
- a7c12de Fix flake in probe scheduler under heavy parallelism

Testing and validation: Unit tests cover the smoother math (decay, weight update, quantile maintenance) and gate transitions. The e2e harness runs multiple traffic shapes (single-cohort, two-cohort alternating, bursty churn) and asserts that: (a) short transient spikes do not trigger immediate rollback, (b) sustained degradation within a majority cohort still triggers rollback within configured budget, and (c) gate enforces extended observation windows when cohort entropy > threshold. CI includes a reproducible synthetic run; flakiness was iterated down from 12% to <2% in multiple re-runs.

Operational notes and rollout plan:
- Feature flag: canary.cohort_smoother.enabled default=false.
- Gradual rollout: enable in staging, then enable for a small subset of internal traffic, then opt-in by customer for dedicated runs.
- Metrics to monitor: cohort_cohesion_score, cohort_entropy, smoother_effective_window_ms, gate_state, canary_stage_duration. Dashboards added under perf/canary/smoother.
- Rollback: immediate opt-out via feature flag or set cohesion_threshold=0 to bypass the smoother.

Backward compatibility and safety: Implementation is additive and disabled by default. Config knobs allow operators to tune aggressiveness. No public API changes.

Review conversation (highlights):

- Luis Gomez [comment]: "Gate looks good but we should expose an emergency bypass for SRE to expedite cutovers during incidents."
  - Daniel Park: "Added gate.bypass_token env var and documented emergency checklist in docs/perf/canary-smoother.md. Also added audit metric gate_bypass_used{true|false}."
- Samantha Ye [approval after fixes]: "Tests look solid and e2e harness reproduces expected behavior for the scenarios I asked for. Approving."

Merge outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-03-02 after approvals from Aisha and Samantha and green CI. Post-merge: created dashboards and an alert that fires when cohort_entropy rises above configured threshold for more than 10 minutes.

Follow-ups and TODOs:
- ENG-3301: add long-run telemetry retention to enable drift analysis across weeks.
- ENG-3318: explore incorporation of request-level feature embeddings to improve cohort grouping (prototype only).
- Ops playbook update: include synthetic run for each major release to confirm smoother stability.

Notes for reviewers: This PR focuses on reducing false positives from short-lived cohort noise while keeping harshness for genuine regressions. The cohesion concept is lightweight and intentionally conservative; downstream default parameters are set to avoid masking real issues. If we see missed regressions in canary history, we can incrementally lower decay factors but will prefer adjusting per-product SLO weights.
